product_metadata.title: SOCHOW Sherpa Fleece Throw Blanket, Double-Sided Super Soft Luxurious Plush Blanket Throw Size, Olive Green
features: UNIQUE DESIGN: SOCHOW high-quality sherpa blanket adopts double-sided design, one side is 280GSM warm sherpa, and the other side is 220GSM soft flannel fleece, which can provide you with different soft feelings. There is enough air inside the blanket to keep it warm and breathable, making you feel warm and fluffy during sleep.
EASY CARE: - Machine washable in warm or cold water - easy to store, wrinkle-resistant. Maintains its color and does not shed.

MULTI FUNCTIONS: The size of this blanket is 50” × 60” and is suitable for use on the couch or bed, a chair, in the car, perfect gift or you can use it on a picnic or camping as it is light weight and packs very small.

COLOR: The sherpa throw blanket is available in a variety of colors, being able to meet your individual requirements. With different colors to choose from, you will easily find the suitable throw blanket to coordinate with your decor.

EXCELLENT AFTER-SALES SERVICE: We believe you will fall in love with this blanket, as it will add warmth to your life. Our motto is: EAST OR WEST, HOME IS BEST. So if you are not satisfied, we will do our best to make you happy with your purchase.
